name: application-subscription-tier-toggle
title: Subscription Tier Toggle
description: Monthly/Annual billing period toggle with a savings badge on the Annual option and a price readout driven by real selection state.
useWhen: Showing a pricing page or plan selector where users choose between monthly and annual billing.
Annual billing offers a discount worth surfacing directly on the toggle, not buried in fine print.
The displayed price should update immediately based on the selected billing period.
avoidWhen: There's no price difference between periods — a plain `toggle-group` without the savings badge is simpler.
You need more than two billing period options (e.g. quarterly too) — extend this pattern or use a `segmented-control` with more segments.
This isn't a binary period choice at all — a generic `toggle-group` fits unrelated two-option toggles better.
responsiveBehavior: Compact pill toggle that stays centered at any width; the price readout wraps to a new line on very narrow containers without breaking layout.
accessibility: The toggle is a role="radiogroup" with two role="radio" options and aria-checked reflecting the selected period — mutually exclusive selection semantics, not two independent buttons.
The savings badge is visible text ("Save 20%"), not conveyed by color or icon alone.
The displayed price and "billed annually" qualifier update together from the same period state, so they never show an inconsistent combination.

variants.title: Subscription Tier Toggle
variants.description: Monthly/Annual toggle with Annual selected, a Save 20% badge, and a $16/month price readout.
accessibility: Clicking Monthly or Annual updates real state, both the toggle's aria-checked and the displayed price together.

variants.title: Subscription Tier Toggle (Dark)
variants.description: Subscription tier toggle adapted for dark surfaces.
